modePad.navigateHint: Navigate (H): the Pencil and a finger move through the music; a tap places the playhead.
modePad.pdfOnly: Not on a PDF's pages: read the notes from the PDF to select and edit them.
modePad.penHint: Pen (P): the Pencil writes on the music and a finger scrolls; without a Pencil, one finger writes and two scroll. The selection stays as it is.
modePad.selectHint: Select (S): draw over the beats with the Pencil to select them; a finger scrolls, and a long press selects. Without a Pencil, one finger selects and two scroll.
pencil.padHint: With Pen on, the Apple Pencil writes on the music and a finger scrolls. Without a Pencil, one finger writes and two scroll.
phrases.hideHint: The phrases are not named, in the contents nor for the selection, until you choose a level again. Kept on this iPad.
pill.cycleHint: On, the selection plays round when playback reaches it; off, playback goes on past it.
pill.playPieceHint: Inside the selection this plays on past it, so Loop turns off.
pill.playSelectionHint: Space. Inside the selection the position is blue; with Loop on it goes round.
recognition.chooseHint: Tick the PDF pieces whose notes to recognise
recognition.failMissing: The piece is no longer in the library
recognition.howLongLine: About {0} min. The pieces done can be opened while the rest wait.
recognition.overLimit: {0} pages are left today: the rest wait until tomorrow.
recognition.stopped.limit: Today's 1000 pages on the Motiff Lab server are used: the rest continue tomorrow
recognition.stopped.needsPro: Recognition on the Motiff Lab server is Pro
recognition.stopped.signIn: Sign in to recognise on the Motiff Lab server
recognition.stopped.unreachable: The recognition server does not answer: recognition is paused
recognition.todayLine: {0} of the {1} pages a day on the Motiff Lab server
recognition.whatLine: The notes go into these same pieces. The PDFs and the marks on them stay as they are.
recognition.whereHere: The PDFs go to the recognition server on this device ({0}); they do not leave it.
recognition.whereHosted: The PDFs go to the Motiff Lab recognition server, which deletes them once read.
recognition.whereOwn: The PDFs go to your recognition server at {0}.
rollMode.editHint: The Pencil moves, adds and takes out notes; a finger moves the roll. Without a Pencil, one finger edits and two move the roll. Nothing is kept until you save.
rollMode.label: Piano roll mode
rollMode.navigateHint: The Pencil and a finger move the roll every way; nothing is selected or edited. Drag across the bar numbers to select, or a handle to change the selection.
settings.playPositionHint: One place where the music is, on the score, the roll and the pill: blue inside the selection, ink outside it. A selection loops while Loop is on, also when playing began before it; a tap on a beat moves the place. The roll shows the loop under the bar numbers and the whole piece above them. The bar chooses what a finger does: Navigate, Select, Edit notes or Pen.
testLibrary.busy: An import or a recognition is running: stop it first. Nothing was deleted.
testLibrary.cleared.many: {0} pieces deleted: the test library on this iPad is empty.
testLibrary.cleared.one: {0} piece deleted: the test library on this iPad is empty.
testLibrary.clearedFailed.many: {0} files could not be deleted; try again.
testLibrary.clearedFailed.one: {0} file could not be deleted; try again.
testLibrary.confirmMessage: Your copies in the test database and the test library on this iPad are deleted: its project files, marks and sync records, the folders added for import and the copies kept for playlists. The test library on your other devices (the web test site, another iPad) is cleared the next time they open the library or sync with this account. Signed out, only this iPad is cleared. Your original files (PDFs, recordings, folders added by link) are never touched, and the Main library stays as it is. This cannot be undone.
testLibrary.hint: Only in the test environment, for a new testing cycle: empties your data in the test database and the test library on every device you sign in with.
testLibrary.notTest: The iPad is not working in the test environment: nothing was deleted.
